justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Directional preference subgroup shows superior outcomes when correctly classified; general LBP evidence is moderate.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Part A through D course progression; four courses total; significant cumulative time and cost.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable across spinal and extremity mechanical diagnoses; broadly useful in outpatient ortho and spine PT.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Standard PT billing; MDT supports mechanical diagnosis documentation for payer justification of musculoskeletal care.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Among the most widely adopted PT specialty training approaches; frequently listed in spine and outpatient PT postings.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Patients value self-management skills and understanding of their condition.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Back/neck pain patients will pay cash for credible spine experts; MDT supports that positioning reasonably well.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Cert McKenzie status supports premium rates, but McKenzie alone is not a consumer power-brand.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Cert MDT is fairly uncommon and provides defensible spine-care positioning.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: More protocolized than most manual methods, so somewhat teachable to associates — moderate scalability.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Patients searching for 'back pain specialist' may recognize McKenzie; modest awareness.
justifications.business.efficiency: 4-part course series plus credentialing exam — meaningful but not extreme commitment.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Well-regarded in ortho/spine academic circles, though not a board specialty.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Strong research tradition with many MDT-trained faculty publishing on classification-based care.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Excellent curricular fit for spine and musculoskeletal modules; classification framework teaches well.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: One of the better-studied conservative spine interventions with multiple RCTs and systematic reviews.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Occasionally preferred, especially at programs emphasizing classification-based ortho care.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Reasonable time investment for the academic credibility it adds.
